ai.lead: An assistant for the day’s questions, a creator that turns a sentence into a rule, and invoice extraction that reads a supplier bill.
ai.seePlans: See how AI fits the plans
ai.assistantTitle: Ask the business. Skip the menus.
ai.assistantPrompt: Who is booked after 4, and which slots are still open?
ai.assistantBody: Check bookings, orders, stock, and customers in plain language. Nothing changes until you confirm.
ai.assistantMeta: On Pro for Orbit Appoint and Orbit Mart, and on the 45-day trial · free messages each day, then the Assistant wallet
ai.autoPrompt: Send a 10% birthday offer the day before.

home.lead: Every Starter and Pro plan ships a white-label mobile app under your business name. Customers book and shop with you — not IE Orbit, not a marketplace. Orbit Appoint for services, Orbit Mart for retail.
home.heroNote: White-label app on every plan · AI assistant, automations, and invoice extraction · 45-day full-Pro trial · UPI · No credit card
home.pathsLead: Choose the momentum you need today. Add the rest when you're ready.
home.pathBookingsBody: Let customers find a time, a service, and a reason to come back.
home.pathShopTitle: A storefront that feels like yours.
home.pathShopBody: Turn your products into an always-open channel your customers can carry.
home.pathBothBody: Bookings and orders, joined up under one memorable brand.
home.benefitWhitelabelBody: The reason to pick Orbit over a billing-only tool. Customers book, shop, and track orders in an app that looks like your business.
home.benefitBiBody: Start with Overview on Starter. Unlock Growth, Revenue, Forecast, and Reports on Pro.
home.benefitUpiBody: Pay with UPI, then claim the payment from your workspace. No credit card required to start.
home.benefitGrowBody: Add extra staff and offices as you scale. Yearly billing charges less than 12 months — typically two months free.
home.step1Body: Tell us how your business grows today — through bookings, products, or both.
home.step2Body: Add your business profile, services or catalog, and invite your team.
home.step3Body: They book and shop in your white-label app. You run the floor in the ops workspace.
home.pricingLead: {{days}}-day full-Pro trial, then Starter ₹{{starter}} or Pro ₹{{pro}} per product/month. White-label customer app on every plan.
